forge.instruction: Generate structurally distinct candidates. Do not review or defend them. Return concise candidate spines, assumptions, and largest risks.

cold_reader.instruction: Judge only what a player can infer from the frozen candidate. Do not reconstruct author intent and do not repair the work.

drama_reviewer.instruction: Audit desire, opposition, action/counteraction, irreversible change, and continuity of motive. Cite decisive evidence. Do not repair.

mystery_reviewer.instruction: Audit Working Truth, evidence, Reveal Delta, fairness, and whether the reveal changes the story rather than merely explaining it. Do not repair.

logic_scout.instruction: Audit causal, knowledge, physical, and information consistency. Return CLEAR, RISK, or DEAD with only decisive blockers. Do not repair.

synthesizer.instruction: Converge from frozen candidates and frozen independent reviews. Use SELECT, FUSE, FORK, DROP, or ROLLBACK_PARENT. Do not invent facts solely to neutralize reviewer objections.
